`r paste0(ana_Cations$Matching_Calibration$DateYYYYMMDD,"_",ana_Cations$Matching_Calibration$Instrument,"_",ana_Cations$Matching_Calibration$Sequence_Type,"_",ana_Cations$Matching_Calibration$Ion_Type,"_",ana_Cations$Matching_Calibration$Number,"_",ana_Anions$Matching_Calibration$Ion_Type,"_",ana_Anions$Matching_Calibration$Number) `

```{r plot-production-anions, results = 'hide', warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Get ions
anion_ion_sp <- unique(str_remove_all(
  colnames(ana_Anions$Data[,grep("Amount",colnames(ana_Anions$Data)):ncol(ana_Anions$Data)]),
  "_Amount|_Area"))
# Loop
anion_plots_qc <- vector('list', length(anion_ion_sp)) %>% 'names<-'(c(anion_ion_sp))
anion_plots_samples <- vector('list', length(anion_ion_sp)) %>% 'names<-'(c(anion_ion_sp))
anion_plots_waters <- vector('list', length(anion_ion_sp)) %>% 'names<-'(c(anion_ion_sp))
for(i in seq_along(anion_ion_sp)){
  # i = 1
  # i
  # message(anion_ion_sp[i])
  # QC plots
  anion_plots_qc[[i]] <- plot_qc_analyte(
    analyte_sequence = ana_Anions,
    analyte_name = anion_ion_sp[i],
    regline_colour = ion_clrs[which(names(ion_clrs) == anion_ion_sp[i])],
    qc_point_colour = 'white')
  # Sample plots
  anion_plots_samples[[i]] <- plot_samples_analyte(
    analyte_sequence = ana_Anions,
    analyte_name = anion_ion_sp[i],
    point_colour = ion_clrs[which(names(ion_clrs) == anion_ion_sp[i])])
  
  anion_plots_waters[[i]]  <- plot_waters_analyte(
    analyte_sequence = ana_Anions,
    analyte_name = anion_ion_sp[i],
    point_colour = ion_clrs[which(names(ion_clrs) == anion_ion_sp[i])])
}

```

## Anions

### Fluoride

```{r Anions-Fluoride, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align='left', dpi = 300, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7 * 6/12}
## ion
ion = "Fluoride"
## Data etc
# analyte_reg <- get_cal_regression(ana_Anions, ion)
analyte_data <- ana_Anions$Data %>%
  select(Injection_Number,Name,Type,Dilution,Level,Calibration, contains(ion)) #%>%
  # mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(.))) #%>% 
  # 'colnames<-'(c(colnames(.)[c(1,2)], "Amount","Area"))#,"Weight"))
## Text
cat(paste0("--------------------------------------", " \n"))
# cat(paste0(ion,", valid n = ",length(which(!is.na(analyte_data$Amount))), ", ",
#            ana_Anions$Cal_Curves$Cal_Type[which(ana_Anions$Cal_Curves$Name == ion)]," \n"))
cat(paste0(ana_Anions$Instrument,
           ", ",
           paste0(ana_Anions$Ion_Type," Summary, ",ana_Anions$Date),
           ", Samples ", 
           ana_Anions$Sample_Range," \n"))
# cat(anion_regressions[[which(anion_ion_sp == ion)]]," \n")
# cat(paste0("R\u00B2 = ", round(summary(analyte_reg)$r.squared,5)," \n"))
# plots
print(anion_plots_qc[[which(anion_ion_sp == ion)]])
# print(anion_plots_res_ppb[[which(anion_ion_sp == ion)]])
print(anion_plots_samples[[which(anion_ion_sp == ion)]])
print(anion_plots_waters[[which(anion_ion_sp == ion)]])
```
